units: World cm including fixed lower Y−0.48cm. Distances/radii/arc lengths in nominal mm, local patch coordinates/metre morph deltas in original glTF metres. Never apply lower opening twice.

rigidEnvelope.certificate: Distance to a closed surface is 1-Lipschitz. All points on the straight segment lie within at most half one dense sample spacing, subtract that from sampled minimum plus 0.0003mm numerical reserve. This certifies a conservative swept capsule radius against BOTH hard-tooth mesh LODs. It is not a soft tissue safety certificate.

brush.bristleNote: Only where a full-radius illustrative cylindrical bristle envelope can reach the hard surfaces. Deflect individual bristles against sampled local surfaces; taper and axial phase may reduce actual contact. A 1.2mm rigid tube does not fit this path. No universal/clinical brush size implied.
brush.ferruleNote: Keep thick sleeve/ferrule nose (its foremost centerline station) at or buccal to maxNoseCenterArcMm for chosen component diameter; sleeve trails behind. Stops computed with 0.08mm radius allowance plus conservative first-bilateral-wall limit. Never scale the sleeve to thread through the corridor. Negative arc is permitted before entry.

plaque.contract: In compact mode replace only the FDI37 patch with mobile37. Positions lie on actual source meshes; UV, normal and indexed faces are native. Tunable render lift 0.02–0.04 mm. edgeWeight gives soft irregular perimeter. Subtract mature lesionExclusion only as cavitation develops. nearestArcMm/pathDistanceMm are exact closest points to finite calibrated path, not a cleaning percentage. Use instantaneous bristle position/radius to reduce ONLY supported, contacted plaque.

36.bristleReachNote: All 16 sampled patch boundary points within 0.594mm of centerline for a free bristle radius 0.60mm. Only animate removal where an actual bristle envelope sweeps this surface (including axial head motion). Never erase a cavitated lesion.

37.bristleReachNote: All 16 sampled patch boundary points within 0.594mm of centerline for a free bristle radius 0.60mm. Only animate removal where an actual bristle envelope sweeps this surface (including axial head motion). Never erase a cavitated lesion.

footprintVisibilityAudit.method: 41 points sampled on three concentric rings plus center; each projected back to true FDI36 mesh surface. Ray from surface +1.2µm normal, test 36 and both 37 LOD meshes. Perspective camera 31mm from anchor. Test tooth surfaces only; gingiva, microscope, brush and other staging occluders are not included.
footprintVisibilityAudit.scope: Fixed healthy 1.2 by 0.8 mm site survey used to select the anchor. This survey covers only part of the enlarged cavity; mature-floor visibility is audited separately.

lesion.wireRelationship: Anchor deliberately coronal and buccal to the 2 mm-apical centerline, on the proximal (distal) enamel of FDI36. Shared-frame positions allow independent lesion indentation and wire interaction without moving teeth.

limitations: Educational hard-surface measurements in an illustrative 21mm reference scale. No gingiva, papilla or bone in this geometry.
No clinical brush size, passage safety, treatment advice or disease timeline can be inferred.
Thickness, plaque, early chalking and mature cavity are authored examples, not conditions in the original Dundee specimen. Brushing does not restore lost tooth structure.
